sections.Profile:
Based on the 1971 Gene Wilder film, Jersey Jack Pinball's 2019 game takes players on a tour of Willy Wonka's factory, collecting Wonka Bars and shooting the Most Secret Machine and the spinning Everlasting Gobstopper on the way down the chocolate river to three wizard modes, including Pure Imagination. Designed by Pat Lawlor with art by John Youssi.
